features: AI FITNESS COACH: Ask the AI to analyse your day, your last 3 days or your last 7 days. It reads your steps, distance and calories against your personal profile and tells you what they mean for you. A built-in goal tracker shows your weekly progress, so you can stay on track to your fitness goals.

ECG HEART HEALTH ANALYSIS: This ECG smart band lets you take a reading anytime to understand your heart rhythm better. Automatic heart rate and HRV tracking run all day, and high heart rate alerts let you know right away when something needs your attention.

COMPLETE HEALTH TRACKING: It tracks SpO2, body temperature, stress and 24-hour sleep, and gives you body composition insights like BMI and body fat. Menstrual cycle tracking makes it a great fitness tracker for women too.

120+ SPORTS MODES + STRAVA SYNC: It tracks steps, distance, calories and 120+ workouts, from running and cycling to gym and yoga. Your data syncs to Strava automatically, and IP68 water resistance handles sweat, rain and handwashing.

NO SUBSCRIPTION, NO HIDDEN COSTS: Pay once and get everything. The AI Fitness Coach, ECG analysis, health reports and your full data history are all included in the app, with no monthly fees or locked premium features.

PREMIUM METAL BUILD + 2 STRAPS IN THE BOX: It has a zinc alloy body, and both a braided and a silicone strap come in the box. You get message alerts, an alarm, reminders for water, medicine and moving, shake-to-take-photo and find-my-band. It works with iPhone and Android.
description: Smart Bracelet for Women, No-Display Fitness Tracker with Heart Rate & Sleep Monitoring, Activity Tracker, Remote Camera Control, Waterproof Wearable with Elegant Chain Design
